sentence: This project builds an artificial intelligence model that uses shortwave infrared cameras to measure how printed concrete sets and predict its bond strength.
This project studies how a class of enzymes that make iron-binding molecules in bacteria and fungi do their work.
This project builds a fleet of battery-operated vehicles that collect data about riders, their mobility and their environment for researchers.
This project studies whether books with science process language increase science learning through parent-child conversation about science.
This project studies how the design of polymers affects their ability to carry genome editor proteins into different types of cells.
This project studies how decorating metal powders with ultra-thin nanomaterials suppresses spatter during laser-based metal additive manufacturing.
This project builds a computational modeling workflow that uses quantum modeling and machine learning to explore mechanical and electronic properties of 2D quantum materials.
This project studies how temperature affects predation by native and invasive crabs on blue mussels, using laboratory experiments and mathematical models.
This project brings together researchers in quantum computing and researchers in classical signal processing to identify common principles.
This project uses machine learning to explore the parameter space of black hole systems and studies how accurate numerical relativity simulations are.
This project studies how realistic constraints such as bounded connectivity and constrained value ranges affect the performance of online decision algorithms.
This project expands a resource that collects wild Caenorhabditis strains and their whole-genome sequence data and adds mapping tools for researchers.
This project studies how deep-learning models can route circuits in order to shorten design time.
